_what: The 11 frame-level moves framectl.py runs, one row per move, same pattern as image-edit's fixes/variations libraries. Each row: what it fixes, the knobs, the local command, and the Higgsfield equivalent when one exists. Page (before/after clips on real music-video footage): (team page)

moves.name: Clean — dedupe & interpolate
moves.what: stutter: AI clips generated at 24fps and padded to 30 repeat every 5th frame — reads as a judder, not motion

knobs.name: --fps
knobs.what: target frame rate

moves.higgsfield: use its upscale/interpolate tool where offered; else run locally, free, on anything

moves.name: Chain from the real last frame
moves.what: jumps between generated clips — the still a clip was aimed at and the frame it actually lands on are never quite the same image

knobs.name: which frame
knobs.what: always the real last frame, never the aim still

knobs.name: which clip order
knobs.what: decided upstream of this

moves.higgsfield: Seedance/Kling: set start_image to that exact frame, end_image to the next still

moves.name: Seam check
moves.what: invisible bad joins — a cut that looks fine paused on either frame can still jump hard once it plays

knobs.name: pass line
knobs.what: fixed

moves.higgsfield: no equivalent — the local gate that decides whether a generated join needs a re-make or a bridge

moves.name: Flow bridge
moves.what: a join that still jumps and can't be re-made from the real last frame — the fallback, not the first move

knobs.name: --k
knobs.what: frames blended on each side of the join

moves.name: Continuous clock — slow dips & push-in
moves.what: “gets stuck”: a frozen hold reads as broken; a static frame that never moves dies on screen

knobs.name: --slow
knobs.what: repeatable: at:width:depth in seconds, depth ≤ 0.8

knobs.name: --push
knobs.what: constant push-in over the whole clip (0.05 = 5%)

moves.higgsfield: speed ramps in the editor's own timeline; push-in is closer to a camera move baked into the prompt

moves.name: Kick surge
moves.what: flat, syncless energy — nothing marks the beat, so the cut feels edited to nothing in particular

knobs.name: --beat
knobs.what: repeatable: a beat time in seconds

knobs.name: --width
knobs.what: how wide the swell is, seconds

knobs.name: --depth
knobs.what: how much scale it adds at the peak

moves.higgsfield: no direct equivalent — bake a small camera push into the generation prompt, or run this after

moves.name: Outfit blend — the look swap
moves.what: a hard cut between two takes of the same motion reads as a glitch, not a transformation

knobs.name: --at
knobs.what: seconds — the centre of the swap

knobs.name: --width
knobs.what: seconds the crossfade spans

moves.higgsfield: Genjutsu motion transfer makes the second take (same motion, new look); this dissolves the two together

moves.name: 360° spin — radial + motion blur
moves.what: a whip-pan or full turn shot at one shutter speed looks like a slideshow, not a spin

knobs.name: --lock
knobs.what: seconds — when the turn begins

knobs.name: --dur
knobs.what: seconds — how long the full turn takes

knobs.name: --bounce-amp
knobs.what: how hard it settles on landing

knobs.name: --bounce-freq
knobs.what: how fast the settle oscillates

moves.higgsfield: motion presets give the turn; they don't add the blur — run this after

moves.name: Eased flick-scroll
moves.what: a scroll timed by the clock looks robotic — a real flick eases by how far the thumb actually moved

knobs.name: --from / --to
knobs.what: seconds — the source span to re-time

knobs.name: --hold
knobs.what: seconds held still before the flick starts

moves.higgsfield: no equivalent — a screen-recording move, always local

moves.name: Pull-back into the screen, in reverse
moves.what: a push into a frame-within-a-frame — a phone, a monitor — that doesn't fill the frame exactly, or land where the next shot begins

knobs.name: --corners
knobs.what: tl,tr,br,bl of the rectangle to push into, in pixels

knobs.name: --land
knobs.what: optional — a frame to land on, for a seamless join

moves.higgsfield: a real 3D camera move is the production route; this is the 2D, locked-off version

moves.name: Seamless loop
moves.what: a loop that visibly jumps at the repeat instead of disappearing into it — “the last frame hands back into the first”

knobs.name: --k
knobs.what: frames morphed at the wrap point

moves.local:
framectl.py loopcheck in.mp4   # measure it first
framectl.py loopclose in.mp4 out.mp4 --k 8
moves.higgsfield: no equivalent — runs on the finished render, after everything else
